recipes.projection: TwoGun mode is on, but TwoGun's board could not be used (No TwoGun snapshot is saved for 2026 week 9 (MAIN slate).); every projection below is the current blend. Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. No coverage leaves the projection blank, flagged "no projection", unless the injury report lists the player as out, on IR, doubtful or suspended, in which case the projection is 0.
recipes.ownership: TwoGun mode is on, but TwoGun's board could not be used; every ownership number below is the current one. Own% is the average, by source weight, of the numbers Weekly findings file, Footballguys percent rostered and RotoWire projected roster % published for the DraftKings main slate; numbers for any other site or slate are never used. Stokastic DK cheat sheet is downloaded, stored and shown in its own column, but never averaged into Own% (weight 0). A number Adam types into the Own% cell replaces the published one for that player. A player with no published number is left blank: the app never estimates ownership, so game popularity exists only where a real number does.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)
